name: voltage-league
description: Voltage League / AR go-kart — M2 Quest OpenXR lab compositor (Phase 0 visual-only)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,ops,hud,quest -c cyan,magenta,green,yellow "npm run dev -w @voltage/backend" "npm run dev -w @voltage/ops" "npm run dev -w @voltage/hud" "npm run dev -w @voltage/quest"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @voltage/ops && npm run build -w @voltage/hud && npm run build -w @voltage/quest
